in_marathi.name: Nilanchala
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nilanchala हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nilanchala is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'nil' meaning blue and 'anchala' meaning lotus. This name is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who is often depicted sitting on a lotus flower. The name symbolizes beauty, purity, and grace.
